title: Assemble an IMU-Lidar Pose Constraint
summary: `imu_lidar_residual(world_from_imu, imu_from_lidar, lidar_relative, std)` world_from_imu(2,4,4),sharedextrinsic(4,4),lidar_relative(4,4) maps lidar-j into lidar-i;std(6)in[1e-6,1000], translationmeters thenrotationradians. Predicted lidarrelative=(Ti Til)^-1(Tj Til). E=lidar_relative^-1 predicted. Return predicted(4,4),translation=E[:3,3] with shape (3,),rotation=Log(E.R)(3),whitened(6)=concattranslation,rotation/std,costhalf norm². Requireprincipalrotationerror<=pi−1e-4. Translation is in measured residual frame; split translation/rotation residual is explicitly NOT full SE3Log translational Jacobian or complete LIO-SAM IMU velocity/bias factor. ExampleextrinsicI,posesI andtranslationx2,measuredtranslationx1,std1=>translation[1,0,0],rotation0,cost.5. ExamplepureIMURz90 with lidarleverarm[1,0,0]=>predictedRz90,translation[-1,1,0],matchingmeasurement giveszero. Knownextrinsics are essential.
